bio: Gaston Vouzote is the sort of authentic brasserie that will bring a smile to your face. From the vintage, Parisian-inspired bistro interior to the cheerful table service, each detail is designed to ensure you enjoy every minute of your meal. A wide range of house-made family favourites oozing in rich, generous flavours is what you can expect ranging from perfectly cooked poached egg with Parma ham and parmesan to tomahawk steak grilled in a Mibrasa charcoal oven or steak tartare crammed with gherkins and capers and served with freshly-made, piping-hot French fries. Just the ticket for fans of no-nonsense tasty nosh that satisfies the appetite and the senses!...
